title: Leviticus Chapter 21 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Leviticus chapter 21 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Leviticus Chapter 21 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Leviticus Chapter 21.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 21:1, who did the LORD command Moses to speak to?
options: The priests, the sons of Aaron
questions.correctAnswer: The priests, the sons of Aaron
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:1 states that the LORD said unto Moses to speak unto the priests, the sons of Aaron.

questions.question: For whom among his people may a priest be defiled according to Leviticus 21:2?
options: For his kin who is near to him
questions.correctAnswer: For his kin who is near to him
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:2 says a priest may be defiled for his kin that is near unto him.

questions.question: Which sister may a priest defile himself for according to Leviticus 21:3?
options: A virgin sister nigh unto him who hath had no husband
questions.correctAnswer: A virgin sister nigh unto him who hath had no husband
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:3 specifies that a priest may defile himself for his virgin sister who hath had no husband.

questions.question: True or False: According to Leviticus 21:4, a chief man among his people shall defile himself to profane himself.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:4 says he shall not defile himself being a chief man among his people to profane himself.

questions.question: What are priests forbidden to do to their heads and beards according to Leviticus 21:5?
options: Not make baldness on their head, not shave the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh
Shave their entire head and beard
Only shave the corners of their beard
Make baldness on their head but not shave their beard
questions.correctAnswer: Not make baldness on their head, not shave the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:5 commands priests not to make baldness on their head, shave off the corner of their beard, or make cuttings in their flesh.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 21:6 teaches that priests shall be holy unto their God and not profane His name.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:6 states that priests shall be holy unto their God and not profane the name of their God.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 21:7, what kind of woman shall priests not take as a wife?
options: A whore or profane woman, or a woman put away from her husband
A virgin of their own people
questions.correctAnswer: A whore or profane woman, or a woman put away from her husband
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:7 prohibits priests from taking a wife that is a whore or profane, or a woman put away from her husband.

questions.question: Who does Leviticus 21:8 say sanctifies the priests?
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD who sanctifies them
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:8 says the LORD sanctifies the priests because they offer the bread of God.

questions.question: True or False: According to Leviticus 21:9, if a priest's daughter profanes herself by playing the whore, she shall be burnt with fire.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:9 states the daughter of any priest who profanes herself by playing the whore shall be burnt with fire.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 21:10, what is the high priest forbidden to do?
options: Uncover his head or rend his clothes
questions.correctAnswer: Uncover his head or rend his clothes
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:10 commands that the high priest shall not uncover his head nor rend his clothes.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT listed in Leviticus 21:11 as something the high priest shall not do?
options: Go in to any dead body
Defile himself for his father or mother
Profane the name of his God
He shall not go in to any dead body or defile himself for his father or mother
questions.correctAnswer: Profane the name of his God
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:11 states the high priest shall not go in to any dead body nor defile himself for his father or mother; it does not mention profaning the name of God here.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 21:13, what kind of wife shall the high priest take?
questions.correctAnswer: A wife in her virginity
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:13 commands the high priest shall take a wife in her virginity.

questions.question: Which of the following women is the high priest prohibited from marrying according to Leviticus 21:14?
options: A widow, divorced woman, profane, or harlot
A virgin of his own people
questions.correctAnswer: A widow, divorced woman, profane, or harlot
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:14 says the high priest shall not take a widow, divorced woman, profane, or harlot, but only a virgin of his own people.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 21:15 says the high priest may profane his seed among his people.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:15 states the high priest shall not profane his seed among his people.

questions.question: In Leviticus 21, which instruction comes first among these: forbidding priests to shave off the corner of their beard, forbidding the high priest to uncover his head, commanding priests to be holy, or telling priests not to defile themselves for the dead?
options: Not to defile themselves for the dead
Not to shave off the corner of their beard
To be holy unto their God
High priest shall not uncover his head
questions.correctAnswer: Not to defile themselves for the dead
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:1-4 first instruct priests not to defile themselves for the dead before mentioning shaving or holiness.

medium.title: Leviticus Chapter 21 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Leviticus Chapter 21 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 21:9, what consequence is given to the daughter of a priest if she profanes herself by playing the whore?
options: She shall be burnt with fire
questions.correctAnswer: She shall be burnt with fire
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:9 explicitly states that the daughter of any priest who profanes herself by playing the whore profanes her father and shall be burnt with fire.

questions.question: What is one restriction placed on the high priest regarding his appearance as described in Leviticus 21:10?
options: He shall not uncover his head nor rend his clothes
He must wear a crown at all times
questions.correctAnswer: He shall not uncover his head nor rend his clothes
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:10 instructs that the high priest, upon whom the anointing oil was poured, shall not uncover his head nor rend his clothes, signifying his consecration and respect for his office.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 21:11, what is the high priest forbidden to do even for his parents?
options: Go in to any dead body or defile himself
Speak to them during his service
Leave the sanctuary for any reason
questions.correctAnswer: Go in to any dead body or defile himself
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:11 explicitly forbids the high priest from going in to any dead body or defiling himself, even for his father or mother, to maintain his holiness.

questions.question: What reason does Leviticus 21:12 give for why the high priest must not profane the sanctuary or go out of it?
options: Because the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him
Because he must guard the sanctuary against enemies
Because he is not allowed to see the people
Because he is under a vow of silence
questions.correctAnswer: Because the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:12 states that the high priest must not go out of the sanctuary or profane it because the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him, symbolizing his sanctification.

questions.question: What requirement does Leviticus 21:13 set for the wife of the high priest?
options: She must be from a foreign nation
questions.correctAnswer: She must be a virgin
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:13 commands that the high priest shall take a wife in her virginity, emphasizing purity and holiness in his family life.

questions.question: Which of the following women is the high priest explicitly forbidden to marry according to Leviticus 21:14?
options: A widow, a divorced woman, a profane woman, or a harlot
questions.correctAnswer: A widow, a divorced woman, a profane woman, or a harlot
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:14 clearly states that the high priest shall not marry a widow, divorced woman, profane woman, or harlot, but only a virgin of his own people.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 21:15 describe the importance of the high priest not profaning his seed among his people?
options: Because the people demand perfect offspring
questions.correctAnswer: Because the LORD sanctifies him
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:15 explains that the high priest must not profane his seed among his people because the LORD sanctifies him, highlighting the divine holiness required in his lineage.

questions.question: What is the connection between Leviticus 21:9 and 21:15 in terms of holiness and family?
options: Both emphasize maintaining holiness within priestly families to avoid profaning God's name
Both allow flexibility in family conduct
Both permit marrying divorced persons to preserve family
Both focus on ritual sacrifices only
questions.correctAnswer: Both emphasize maintaining holiness within priestly families to avoid profaning God's name
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:9 and 21:15 together stress the importance of holiness within priestly families, condemning profaning behavior such as prostitution and profaning one’s seed, to uphold God's sanctity.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 21:10-12, what does the high priest's anointing oil symbolize in relation to his conduct?
options: It symbolizes his sanctification and the necessity to avoid profaning himself or the sanctuary
It symbolizes his wealth and status
It symbolizes his authority to judge Israel
It symbolizes his right to marry anyone
questions.correctAnswer: It symbolizes his sanctification and the necessity to avoid profaning himself or the sanctuary
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:10-12 portrays the anointing oil as a symbol of the high priest's sanctification, requiring him to avoid uncovering his head, rending clothes, defiling himself, or profaning the sanctuary.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 21:14 allows the high priest to marry a divorced woman as long as she is from his own people.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:14 specifically forbids the high priest from marrying a divorced woman, regardless of her origin, emphasizing the requirement for a virgin wife from his own people.

questions.question: What does Leviticus 21:15 imply about the importance of the priest's offspring in relation to God's sanctification?
options: The priest must not profane his seed among his people because God sanctifies him
The priest's offspring must be wealthy
The priest's children must become priests automatically
The priest's offspring should marry outside Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The priest must not profane his seed among his people because God sanctifies him
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:15 highlights that the priest must keep his offspring holy and not profane them because the LORD sanctifies him, meaning his family life reflects divine holiness.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 21:11 allows the high priest to defile himself for his parents by going into a dead body.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:11 clearly forbids the high priest from going into any dead body or defiling himself even for his father or mother to maintain his holiness.

questions.question: If the high priest obeys the command in Leviticus 21:12 not to profane the sanctuary or go out of it, what does this show about his relationship with God?
options: He honors the LORD who sanctified him and respects the sanctity of his office
He avoids all contact with the people
He maintains political power over Israel
questions.correctAnswer: He honors the LORD who sanctified him and respects the sanctity of his office
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:12 indicates that by not profaning the sanctuary or leaving it, the high priest honors the LORD who sanctified him, maintaining the holiness required by his role.

questions.question: What practical lesson about integrity and holiness can believers learn from the high priest's restrictions about marriage in Leviticus 21:13-14?
options: God calls his servants to purity and holiness even in their personal relationships
Marriage is unimportant for spiritual leaders
Any marriage is acceptable if it brings peace
questions.correctAnswer: God calls his servants to purity and holiness even in their personal relationships
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:13-14 teaches that the high priest must marry a virgin and not a widow or divorced woman, illustrating that God expects purity and holiness in all areas, including personal relationships.

questions.question: True or False: According to Leviticus 21:16, the LORD spoke to Moses to continue giving instructions about the priests.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:16 confirms that the LORD continued to speak to Moses, giving further instructions concerning the priests, showing ongoing divine guidance.

hard.title: Leviticus Chapter 21 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Leviticus Chapter 21.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 21:17-21, which physical condition disqualifies a descendant of Aaron from offering the bread of God?
options: A man with a full beard
questions.correctAnswer: A blind man
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:18 states that a blind man is among those with blemishes who shall not approach to offer the bread of God.

questions.question: What is the fate of a priest who has a blemish, according to Leviticus 21:22-23?
options: He may enter the veil and offer sacrifices
He shall eat the bread of God but not enter the veil or approach the altar
He shall be exiled from Israel
He shall be anointed as high priest
questions.correctAnswer: He shall eat the bread of God but not enter the veil or approach the altar
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:22-23 explains that a priest with a blemish may eat the bread of God but must not enter the veil or approach the altar to avoid profaning the sanctuaries.

questions.question: Which category of women is a high priest forbidden to marry according to Leviticus 21:13-14?
questions.correctAnswer: A widow
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:14 clearly states that a high priest must not marry a widow, divorced, profane, or harlot woman, but only a virgin of his own people.

questions.question: What is the reason given in Leviticus 21:8 for the priests to be holy unto God?
options: Because they offer the bread of God
Because they live in the wilderness
Because they are descendants of David
questions.correctAnswer: Because they offer the bread of God
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:8 explains that priests must be holy because they offer the bread of God, and the LORD who sanctifies them is holy.

questions.question: Which action is forbidden for the high priest during mourning, according to Leviticus 21:10-12?
options: Defiling himself for his parents' dead
questions.correctAnswer: All of the above
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:10-11 forbids the high priest from uncovering his head, rending his clothes, or defiling himself by coming near a dead body, including his parents.

questions.question: True or False: According to Leviticus 21:5, priests were allowed to shave off the corners of their beards as a sign of mourning.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:5 forbids priests from shaving off the corners of their beards or making cuttings in their flesh, indicating they should maintain their appearance.

questions.question: What consequence is given in Leviticus 21:9 for a priest's daughter who profanes herself by playing the harlot?
options: She shall be expelled from the community
She shall be burnt with fire
She shall be forgiven after repentance
questions.correctAnswer: She shall be burnt with fire
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:9 states that if a priest's daughter profanes herself by playing the harlot, she profanes her father and shall be burnt with fire.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage shares a similar theme of priestly holiness and restrictions as Leviticus 21?
questions.correctAnswer: Exodus 28
questions.explanation: Exodus 28 details the priestly garments and holiness requirements, paralleling Leviticus 21’s focus on priestly purity and conduct (Leviticus 21:6, Exodus 28).

questions.question: What is the Hebrew meaning of the word translated as 'blemish' in Leviticus 21:17 and how does it affect priestly duties?
options: Defect or imperfection; disqualifies from offering sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: Defect or imperfection; disqualifies from offering sacrifice
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word 'makkat' translated as blemish refers to a physical defect or imperfection that disqualifies a priest from offering sacrifices (Leviticus 21:17-18).

questions.question: How does the restriction in Leviticus 21:11 on the high priest avoiding defilement by contact with the dead reflect the broader biblical theme of holiness?
options: Holiness requires separation from death and impurity
Holiness is only about ritual cleanliness
questions.correctAnswer: Holiness requires separation from death and impurity
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:11 restricts the high priest from defiling himself by touching the dead, emphasizing the biblical theme that holiness requires separation from death and impurity (cf. Numbers 19).

questions.question: Which New Testament passage echoes the theme of priestly holiness and purity found in Leviticus 21?
questions.correctAnswer: Hebrews 7
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7 discusses the priesthood of Melchizedek and the holiness required of priests, echoing themes in Leviticus 21 about priestly sanctity and qualifications.

questions.question: What literary device is used in Leviticus 21 to emphasize the holiness and separation of the priesthood?
options: Inclusio framing holiness commands with 'holy' and 'sanctify'
questions.correctAnswer: Inclusio framing holiness commands with 'holy' and 'sanctify'
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21 uses inclusio by framing instructions with repeated terms like 'holy' and 'sanctify' to emphasize the priesthood's separation and sanctity (Leviticus 21:6, 8, 15, 23).

questions.question: According to Leviticus 21:7, what type of woman must a priest not marry?
questions.correctAnswer: A whore or profane woman
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:7 forbids priests from marrying a woman who is a whore or profane, emphasizing the need for holiness in their marriage.

questions.question: True or False: According to Leviticus 21:24, Moses communicated these priestly laws only to Aaron, not to his sons or the people of Israel.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:24 states Moses told the priestly laws to Aaron, his sons, and all the children of Israel, indicating wide communication.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT listed as a blemish disqualifying a priest from offering sacrifices in Leviticus 21:18-20?
questions.correctAnswer: Long hair
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:18-20 lists physical defects such as crookback, dwarf, brokenhanded, but does not mention long hair as a disqualifying blemish.

theological.title: Leviticus Chapter 21 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Leviticus Chapter 21 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 21:1, for whom are the priests forbidden to defile themselves by contact with the dead?
options: For the dead among his people
questions.correctAnswer: For the dead among his people
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:1 commands that priests shall not defile themselves for the dead among their people, emphasizing their need for ritual purity.

questions.question: Which relatives are priests permitted to become defiled for according to Leviticus 21:2?
questions.correctAnswer: Mother, father, son, daughter, brother
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:2 lists specific close relatives—mother, father, son, daughter, brother—for whom priests may become defiled, showing exceptions to the general rule.

questions.question: What condition is placed on a sister for a priest to defile himself for her, as stated in Leviticus 21:3?
options: She must be a virgin who has had no husband
questions.correctAnswer: She must be a virgin who has had no husband
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:3 clarifies that a priest may defile himself for a sister only if she is a virgin who has had no husband, emphasizing ritual purity.

questions.question: What restriction is placed on priests regarding their appearance in Leviticus 21:5?
options: They shall not make baldness upon their head, shave the corner of their beard, or make cuttings in their flesh
They must shave their heads completely
They must wear long hair and beards
questions.correctAnswer: They shall not make baldness upon their head, shave the corner of their beard, or make cuttings in their flesh
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:5 commands priests to avoid certain physical markings like baldness and shaving parts of their beard, symbolizing their holiness.

questions.question: What divine attribute is emphasized in Leviticus 21:6 when priests are instructed to be holy and not profane God's name?
questions.correctAnswer: God's holiness
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:6 stresses the holiness of God and the necessity of priests reflecting that holiness to avoid profaning His name.

questions.question: What does Leviticus 21:7 forbid priests from doing in relation to marriage?
options: Taking a wife who is a whore, profane, or put away from her husband
questions.correctAnswer: Taking a wife who is a whore, profane, or put away from her husband
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:7 prohibits priests from marrying women who defile themselves or have been divorced, underscoring the priest's holiness.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 21:8 describe the reason priests must be holy?
options: Because they offer the bread of God and are sanctified by the LORD who is holy
Because they are chosen by the congregation
questions.correctAnswer: Because they offer the bread of God and are sanctified by the LORD who is holy
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:8 explains that priests must be holy since they offer offerings to God and are sanctified by the LORD Himself, who is holy.

questions.question: What severe penalty does Leviticus 21:9 prescribe for a priest's daughter who profanes herself by playing the whore?
options: She shall be burnt with fire
questions.correctAnswer: She shall be burnt with fire
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:9 mandates the burning of a priest's daughter who defiles herself, highlighting the seriousness of profaning the priestly family.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 21:10, what is forbidden to the high priest regarding mourning rituals?
options: He shall not uncover his head nor rend his clothes
He shall not eat mourning food
He shall not speak to mourners
He shall not enter the city
questions.correctAnswer: He shall not uncover his head nor rend his clothes
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:10 forbids the high priest from uncovering his head or tearing his clothes, maintaining his sanctity during mourning.

questions.question: What is the high priest forbidden to do for his parents, as stated in Leviticus 21:11?
options: He shall not go in to any dead body nor defile himself
He shall not speak to them
He shall not provide for them
He shall not honor them publicly
questions.correctAnswer: He shall not go in to any dead body nor defile himself
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:11 commands that the high priest must not defile himself by contact with any dead body, even his parents, to preserve sanctity.

questions.question: What restriction about the high priest’s relationship to the sanctuary is given in Leviticus 21:12?
options: He shall not go out of the sanctuary nor profane it
He shall only enter the sanctuary once a year
He must leave the sanctuary during festivals
He must not enter the sanctuary at all
questions.correctAnswer: He shall not go out of the sanctuary nor profane it
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:12 highlights the high priest’s unique consecration and responsibility to keep the sanctuary holy and not profane it.

questions.question: What specific requirement for the high priest’s wife is set in Leviticus 21:13?
options: He shall take a wife in her virginity
He shall marry a foreign woman
He shall not marry at all
questions.correctAnswer: He shall take a wife in her virginity
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:13 mandates that the high priest must marry a virgin, underscoring the theme of purity in priestly service.

questions.question: What combined doctrinal insight do Leviticus 21:17 and 21:21 provide about priests with blemishes?
options: Priests with physical blemishes are not permitted to offer the bread of God
All priests regardless of blemishes may serve equally
Only the high priest may have blemishes
Blemishes are considered signs of honor
questions.correctAnswer: Priests with physical blemishes are not permitted to offer the bread of God
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:17 and 21:21 together teach that any priest with physical defects may not approach to offer sacrifices, emphasizing the doctrinal principle of holiness and perfection in worship.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 21:22-23 balance the restriction on blemished priests with their participation in God’s provision?
options: They may eat the holy bread but not enter the veil or approach the altar
They are completely excluded from all priestly benefits
They may offer sacrifices but not eat the bread
They have no role whatsoever in the sanctuary
questions.correctAnswer: They may eat the holy bread but not enter the veil or approach the altar
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:22-23 allows blemished priests to partake of holy food, showing God’s provision, but forbids them from entering the veil or approaching the altar to maintain sanctuary holiness.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that Leviticus 21’s restrictions on priests reflect arbitrary ancient purity laws irrelevant to modern faith. What does Leviticus 21:6-8 actually teach about the nature of God and priesthood?
options: God’s holiness demands that His priests also be holy because they represent Him before the people
The laws are purely cultural with no divine significance
The priests are only symbolic and do not require holiness
God accepts any person regardless of their state
questions.correctAnswer: God’s holiness demands that His priests also be holy because they represent Him before the people
questions.explanation: Leviticus 21:6-8 emphasizes that God is holy and sanctifies the priests who offer His offerings, teaching the theological principle that divine holiness requires human holiness in mediators, countering the sceptic’s claim.
